expectations.text: Happiness is a choice and a skill you can develop/learn
expectations.evidence: Section 1 quotes 'Happiness is a choice you make and a skill you develop.'

expectations.text: Desire is a contract you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want
expectations.evidence: Section 2 quotes the desire-contract line verbatim

expectations.text: Happiness = state when nothing is missing and/or peace is happiness at rest
expectations.evidence: Section 1: 'the state when nothing is missing'; 'Peace is happiness at rest'

expectations.text: Success doesn't earn happiness and/or envy is the enemy of happiness
expectations.evidence: Section 3: success doesn't earn happiness; 'Envy is the enemy of happiness'

expectations.text: Built by habits such as meditation (and exercise, reading)
expectations.evidence: Section 4: meditation, exercise, less screen time

expectations.text: Mentions presence/acceptance or 'retirement is when you stop sacrificing today for an imaginary tomorrow'
expectations.evidence: Section 5: acceptance, present moment, quotes the retirement line
